name: straight_two_band_return_line_20261103
known_tradeoff: Compared with the later 500-update ratio/recovery-start model, this selected model has lower mean lateral endpoint offset at 1.25 and 1.5 m/s, but higher offset at 2 m/s. It is the user's selected straight baseline; the speed-specific limitations remain documented in the paired summaries.
inference_interface: At 50 Hz: history[N,270], signed yaw rate (rad/s), heading and lateral-offset errors (N,3), history_ids[N,14] int64 initialized to ones, alphas[N,2] initialized to zeros -> executed action[N,12], next_ids, next_alphas. Reset recurrent state on environment reset. Straight commands only. The policy includes its own stand/walk blend.
